source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sharpness of resonance and standing waves (PDF 38-41).

blocks.text: Resonance par oscillator ka amplitude bohat bara ho jata hai. Amplitude aur resonance ki tezi (sharpness) dono damping par munhasir hain: damping jitni kam, amplitude utna zyada aur resonance utni tez. Bohat damped nizam ka amplitude-frequency graph par resonance curve kafi chapta hota hai (Fig 14.20).

Damping ka asar dekhne ke liye aik rod se halke bob (jaise pith ball) wala pendulum aur usi lambai ka barabar size ke bhari lead bob wala doosra pendulum latkayein, aur unhein usi lambai ke teesre pendulum se chalayein. Lead bob ka amplitude pith ball se kaheen zyada ho jata hai, kyunke hawa ki mazahmat halki pith ball ko bhari lead bob se kaheen zyada damp karti hai.

blocks.alt: Driving frequency ke muqable amplitude ka graph. Teenon curves qudrati frequency (dashed amudi lakeer) ke qareeb chotti banate: halki damping tez, oonchi chotti (surkh), darmiyani damping neechi, chauri chotti (narangi), aur bhari damping neecha, taqreeban chapta curve (neela).
blocks.caption: Resonance ki tezi (Fig 14.20 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Kam damping mein tawanai sirf qudrati frequency ke bohat qareeb zor se jama hoti hai, jis se oonchi, tang chotti banti hai. Bhari damping tawanai itni tezi se nikalti hai ke har frequency par amplitude chhota rehta hai.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein: Tacoma Narrows pul
blocks.text: Pulon aur doosri imaraton ke design mein resonance ahem hai. Tacoma Narrows pul (Washington, USA) July 1940 mein khula; chaar mahine baad darmiyani hawa ne use bare jhoolon mein daal diya, aur chand ghanton mein pul ka hissa toot kar pani mein gir gaya (kitab tasveer dikhati hai). Engineers ab is ki wajah aeroelastic flutter batate hain, hawa se chalne wala khud-qaim jhoolna, jo resonance se gehra talluq rakhta hai.
Resonance aur standing waves ke istemal
Bohat se aalaat standing waves banate aur use karte hain, aur standing waves aur resonance ka talluq Rubens tube, Chladni plates aur acoustic levitation se parha ja sakta hai.

items: Rubens tube (Fig 14.21): dhaat ka lamba pipe jis ke oopar soorakhon ki qatar ho, dono sire band; aik sire par frequency generator se chalne wala chhota loudspeaker aur doosra aag pakarne wali gas ki supply se jura. Soorakhon se nikalti gas jalayi jati hai. Resonant frequency par tube mein standing wave banti hai; jahan dabao sab se zyada badalta wahan zyada gas nikalti, is liye wahan shoale oonche aur nodes par neeche hote, jo standing wave dikhate hain.

Chladni plate (Fig 14.22): chaukor ya gol dhaat ki plate jo markaz se vibrator par lagi ho (ya kinare par bow se bajayi jaye). Resonant mode ki frequency par plate par nodes aur antinodes bante hain. Plate par chhirki ret antinodes se hil kar door hoti aur nodal lakeeron par, jo harkat nahi karti, jama ho kar naqsha dikhati hai.

Acoustic levitation (Fig 14.23): transducer ki unchi frequency (ultrasonic) awaz reflector se mun'akis hoti, aur aane wali aur mun'akis lehrein standing wave banati hain. Styrofoam ke tukre ya pani ki boondein jaise chhote zarrat kashish-e-saql ke khilaf pressure nodes par thame rehte hain, jo awaz ke jaal (acoustic traps) ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: Rubens tube; gas ki botal aik lambe pipe ko gas deti jis ke aik sire par speaker hai; andar neeli standing wave aur oopar narangi shoalon ki qatar tube ke saath oonchi neechi hoti. Neeche baen: markazi dande par chaukor Chladni plate, nodal lakeeron par ret ki narangi lakeerein. Neeche daen: acoustic levitation; neeche ultrasonic transducer aur oopar reflector ke darmiyan dashed node jagahon par chhote surkh zarrat tairte.
blocks.caption: Laboratory mein standing waves aur resonance (Figs 14.21 se 14.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har aale mein standing wave sirf resonant frequency par banti hai, aur koi nazar aane wali cheez, shoale, ret ya tairte zarrat, us ke nodes aur antinodes ki jagah dikhati hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Rubens tube, jise standing-wave flame tube bhi kehte hain, German physicist Heinrich Rubens ne 1905 mein ijad ki. Chladni plates physicist aur musiqi ke saaz banane wale Ernst Chladni (1756-1827) ne 18vi sadi ke aakhir mein standing-wave thartharahat ke pecheeda naqshe dikhane ke liye ijad kin.

blocks.title: Sargarmi
blocks.text: Aap ke ustad class mein resonance tube ya Chladni plate se resonance aur standing waves ka talluq dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do aik jaise pendulum, aik pith-ball bob aur aik usi size ke lead bob wala, un ki qudrati frequency par chalaye jate hain. Kis ka amplitude zyada hoga, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Lead bob ka. Hawa ki mazahmat halki pith ball ko kaheen zyada damp karti hai, aur kam damping zyada bari, tez resonance deti hai.

items: Kam damping: zyada amplitude aur tez resonance; bhari damping: chapta curve.
Tacoma Narrows (1940): hawa se jhoolne ne pul tabah kiya.
Standing waves: Rubens tube, Chladni plate, acoustic levitation.
